name: labs/alexshkarin__pylablib
title: Thorlabs Kinesis motor controller (pylablib KinesisMotor)
intro: Thorlabs Kinesis motor controller (pylablib KinesisMotor), adapted from alexshkarin/pylablib. It reads `position`, `moving`, `homed`, `status` and 2 more; sets `max_velocity`; runs `home_axis`, `stop_motion` and `move_to_absolute`. `home_axis`: home the axis with the native MOT_HOME and report the homed bit; it takes no input. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
